subject: Partner qualification + schedule sync — next steps for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@astercloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + AsterCloud — quick follow-up + next meeting

Hi Evelyn / Camila / Marcus,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the high-level product overview and how Redwood handles multi-environment inference. As discussed on the call, we (AsterCloud) are evaluating a marketplace integration that can surface Redwood as a managed inference runtime for our GSI customers.

Quick recap of what matters to us:
- Predictable throughput guarantees for partner-managed faces (SLA targets + burst behavior)
- Security requirements (KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2 evidence)
- Pricing model for marketplace listings and revenue share outline

Next steps we want to align on:
1) Technical deep dive with your infra/serving runtime team to validate kernel/quantization options and API surface — target 60 minutes.
2) Joint MAP (mutual action plan) draft so we can show the GTM and procurement timeline to our sellers.
3) Share a short security one-pager and any SOC2 artifacts we can reference internally.

Availability from our side next week: Tue/Wed mornings (PDT) or Thu afternoon. If you can propose 2 slots, we’ll confirm quickly.

Attaching a short outline of the MAP we’d like to co-author.

Attachments: MVP-MAP-AsterCloud-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Cheers,
Liam
Partner Strategy — AsterCloud Solutions
liam.oneill@astercloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Liam — great to meet you on the call today, and thanks for the clear recap.

We're aligned on the three asks. Quick replies inline:
- Technical deep dive: Marcus (copied) will run the deep dive and cover runtime internals, compatibility, and quantization tradeoffs. 60 min is perfect.
- MAP: happy to co-author; Camila will help shape the GTM milestones.
- Security artifacts: attaching our one-pager; we can follow up with SOC2 evidence via our security portal once we complete the NDA/POC paperwork.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 2026-08-18 09:30–10:30
- Wed 2026-08-19 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2026-08-20 14:00–15:00
